risks.risk: FFmpeg dependency, codec exposure, patent/build configuration, and dynamic library compatibility.
risks.mitigation: Keep FFmpeg review separate; no broad codec/runtime use until later approval.

risks.risk: libvips LGPL-2.1-or-later, native binary, optional dependency, and untrusted image handling.
risks.mitigation: Worker-only isolation, LGPL compliance review, and image safety QA before runtime.

risks.risk: Native wheel/platform footprint and GUI dependency risk.
risks.mitigation: Prefer opencv-python-headless in worker images and keep frontend imports forbidden.

risks.risk: OpenCV dependency and false scene-boundary candidates.
risks.mitigation: Use generated fixtures first and require manual/QA thresholds before controlled media.

risks.risk: Extension loading, network access, local file IO, and private metadata leakage.
risks.mitigation: Disable unapproved extensions/network paths and commit only redacted summaries.

risks.risk: CPU feature compatibility, memory pressure, and schema drift.
risks.mitigation: Use compatibility-aware worker images and deterministic schema tests in Phase 46D.
